key_facts: Fresh enumeration: ETH MiningNFT 11 mints / 1,914 units; BSC 12 mints / 1,857 units; log-netting shows every unit sits in FILSTManage on both chains
BSC FILSTManage/MiningNFT/MiningNFTManage/MinerManage are bytecode-identical to verified ETH sources (unverified-on-BSC gap closed)
FILST supply equals escrowed units x 1024 on both chains (no net burns): 1,959,936 ETH / 1,901,568 BSC
The custom reserve-keeper _reduceReserves(receiver,amount) design is caller-accrued-gated; ceFIL's keeper (PR contract, 14.2M EFIL accrued) cannot be triggered by anyone
EFIL on Ethereum has no market (checked Uni V2, Sushi V2, Uni V3, holders) - this is why the mechanically-open ceFIL borrow realizes $0
cFILST markets are CollateralOnlyCErc20 on BOTH chains (borrow returns BAD_INPUT)
The Compound-fork DFL first-supplier history-capture bug is absent on both chains (fork-proven)
LP float precision: ETH 8.4e-5 LP (~$122, EOA + smart wallet) / BSC 24.97 LP (~$19) - holder-recoverable
caveats: Read-only; no mainnet transactions; no secrets
BSC leg uses BSC_RPC_URL in CI with a public fallback; if the BSC RPC is unavailable, only the 7 BSC tests are affected
EFIL venue absence is as of the fork block; a newly deployed venue could change C4's realized value
USD values are pool-implied (FILST/DFL have no oracle market)
one_liner: Adversarial re-audit could not break the DeFIL closure: every fresh keyless route (NFT acquisition, LP unstuck, stale-oracle borrows on both chains, DFL history capture, reserve keeper, migration) resolves to $0 - closure stands, high confidence; conditional paths are all key-compromise or legacy-position gated.
